about: Every field EA's Pro Clubs API sends, what it means and how sure we are of it. Only mark a field 'verified' after checking it against real data, and note the evidence. docs/ea-api.md is generated from this file: run `node scripts/ea-docs.mjs` after editing, and `node scripts/ea-docs.mjs <folder of saved responses>` to list fields EA sends that aren't documented here yet.

thanks.thanks: Thank you for working these out and publishing them.

evidence.note: Player lines include both clubs. EA's API keeps only the last 10 matches per type, so everything older exists only in our database (matches.raw).

status.verified: Checked against real data; safe to build on.
status.assumed: Meaning follows from the name or a few examples, not proven.
status.unknown: Seen in the data, meaning not worked out.
status.useless: Always the same value, or contradicts other fields.

api.platform: every call needs ?platform=common-gen5 (current gen) or common-gen4
api.botFilter: EA rejects clients whose TLS fingerprint doesn't match a browser; scripts/fetch-ea.py uses curl_cffi with impersonate='chrome'
api.caching: EA's edge caches identical URLs for minutes; add a unique query param (e.g. _=timestamp)
api.values: almost every number arrives as a string ("54", not 54)
api.notFound: tried 2026-10-11, all HTTP 404: clubs/search, seasonRankLeaderboard, clubs/seasonalStats, clubs/playoffAchievements, members/archetypes, members/archetype/stats, members/stats/archetypes, members/seasonal/stats
notAvailable: matches older than the last 10 per match type
minute-by-minute events, goal times, xG, heatmaps
season totals per archetype (only the in-game Archetypes > Statistics screen has them)
Rush, Live Tournament and Drop In matches (empty for this club)

clubs/matches.about: The club's last 10 games of one type, newest first. Each game has both clubs, every human player's line and a total per club. Promotion match games come as leagueMatch. The site saves every game from here (matches.raw), because EA drops them after 10.

timeAgo.number, timeAgo.unit.meaning: how long ago, relative to the request (e.g. 2 hours); not stored

sections.title: Each club in the game
sections.about: Keyed by club id: ours (837026) and the opponent's.

winnerByDnf.meaning: 1 = won because the other club quit

wins.meaning: 1 if this club won this game

losses.meaning: 1 if this club lost this game

matchType.note: verified 2026-10-11: promotion series games (Lier City, Division 4 → 3) come from the leagueMatch endpoint with matchType 1, so the site tells them apart only by replaying the season (points target reached)

TEAM.meaning: the club's crest at the time of the game: the custom crest's asset id (99xxxxxx), or the base team id for clubs using a real team's crest
TEAM.evidence: ours was 99070108 for 13 games, then 99160622 for the last 3, which is our current crestAssetId; opponents' values match their crestAssetId or teamId

regionId.meaning: region as ASCII text in hex: 5719381 = 0x574555 = "WEU" (Western Europe); a trailing digit can mark a sub-region

teamId.meaning: probably the base team the club was created from

sections.title: Club kits, crest and stadium
sections.about: Colours are RGB as a decimal number: 11786 = #002E0A.

stadName.meaning: stadium name; default clubs show 'Tier 1 Stadium' in their language

kitColor1-4.meaning: home kit colours (body, trim, sleeve, extra)
kitColor1-4.usedFor: kit shirts on match pages (matches.our_kit / opp_kit)

selectedKitType.meaning: which kit was worn: 0 home, 1 away, 2 third

kitId, customKitId, customAwayKitId, cus.meaning: kit design ids (pattern, template); no public image source

seasonalTeamId, seasonalKitId.meaning: seasonal kit ids; 0 for clubs without one

sections.title: Each player's line
sections.about: Keyed by club id, then the player's EA account id. Only humans get a line: the CPU teammates' stats are added to whoever controls them.

pos.meaning: broad group only: goalkeeper / defender / midfielder / forward
pos.usedFor: position on match pages (exact slot only via Fix stats)

archetypeid.meaning: FC 27 archetype played, numbered in the game's order (keepers, defenders, midfielders, forwards)
archetypeid.evidence: 1-2 only on keepers, 3-5 on defenders, 6-10 on midfielders, 11-13 on forwards; mo_nm's in-game Archetypes screen (2026-10-11) shows Target, Finisher and Sweeper Keeper, and his saved games are 13 and 2
archetypeid.confirmed: 2026-10-11 by the club: dirty8ightt Creator (midfield) and Magician (up front), mo_nm Target
archetypeid.usedFor: By archetype table and season-by-archetype cards on player pages

goals.meaning: EA's goals; on the line of whoever controls the CPU this INCLUDES the CPU teammates' goals
goals.usedFor: shown as 'EA: n incl. CPU'; own goals come from counter 214

assists.meaning: as goals: includes CPU assists on the controller's line

shots.meaning: as goals: includes CPU shots on the controller's line

passesmade.meaning: completed passes; includes CPU on the controller's line

passattempts.meaning: attempted passes; includes CPU on the controller's line

tacklesmade.meaning: won tackles; includes CPU on the controller's line

tackleattempts.meaning: attempted tackles; includes CPU on the controller's line

redcards.meaning: red cards; may include CPU cards on the controller's line

reflexSaves, parrySaves, punchSaves, bal.meaning: saves by type; they add up to less than saves (mo_nm 16 of 21), the rest are untyped
reflexSaves, parrySaves, punchSaves, bal.usedFor: Saves by type on player and match pages

goalsconceded.meaning: goals conceded while this player was on the pitch

cleansheetsdef.evidence: the only 1 seen is a defender in a 0-conceded game; forwards and midfielders in the same kind of game have 0

cleansheetsgk.meaning: probably 1 = clean sheet as keeper; no keeper clean sheet saved yet

secondsPlayed.meaning: in-game seconds on the pitch (90 min ≈ 5400)

realtimegame.meaning: real-world seconds in the match (~15-17 min for 90)
realtimegame.note: one outlier of 7052 s (EnEsC-37), maybe time in the lobby

wins, losses.meaning: mirror the club result for this player

userResult.evidence: 6 on 5 lines, all in games our side lost by quitting (result 10); 0 everywhere else

namespace.meaning: the player's platform account type: 1 = PlayStation, 3 = Xbox (crossplay)
namespace.evidence: 1 on all our PS5 players (104 lines); 3 only on 7 opponents

match_event_aggregate_0-3.meaning: hidden per-player event counters, see matchEventCounters
match_event_aggregate_0-3.usedFor: own goals, assists and shots (not the CPU's)

sections.title: Club totals
sections.about: Same fields as a player line, summed over the club's human players.

*.meaning: the club's player lines summed, including fields where a sum means nothing (rating, archetypeid); pos is 0
*.evidence: rating and archetypeid equal the sums of the player lines on every saved game

clubs/info.about: A club's name, region, crest, kits and stadium. Same fields as 'Club details' and 'Club kits' in a match.

*.usedFor: crest, kits and stadium on the club page

clubs/overallStats.query: clubIds=<one id> (several ids return HTTP 400; works for any club)
clubs/overallStats.about: The club's season record, streaks, Skill Rating and reputation.

gamesPlayedPlayoff.meaning: games in EA's playoff type; 0 so far (promotion games count as league)

skillRating.meaning: Elo-style rating used for matchmaking; matches the in-game Season Info (1438 on 2026-10-11)
skillRating.usedFor: club page; matches.our_sr / opp_sr, saved when a game is first seen (opponents looked up for games under 3 h old); /analysis opponent strength

lastMatch0-9.note: only 5 filled although more games were played; maybe resets with the season

lastOpponent0-9.meaning: club ids of recent opponents, 0 = newest
lastOpponent0-9.note: back-to-back games against the same club count once, so it does NOT line up with lastMatch

bestFinishGroup.meaning: None so far; probably the best Season Playoffs placing

finishesInDivision1-6Group1.meaning: all 0 so far; probably how often the season ended in each division

allTimeLeaderboard/search.about: Clubs whose name matches, with their record and division. The site finds itself by club id among the results.

currentDivision.meaning: says 5, but the in-game League Lobby showed Division 4 on 2026-10-11, matching our season tracker; don't use it for the current division

points.meaning: 29 on 2026-10-11 (24 a day earlier); not the current division's points (tracker: 10 of 9)

allTimeLeaderboard.about: The top 100 clubs on the platform by Skill Rating (2441 down to 2132 on 2026-10-11). Not used by the site.

skillRating.meaning: Skill Rating; the list is sorted by it

currentDivision, bestDivision.meaning: 1 or 2 for every top club; see the warning on currentDivision in allTimeLeaderboard/search

reputationlevel.meaning: finer reputation level inside the tiers: tier 0 = level 3, tier 1 = levels 4-6, tier 2 = levels 7-8
reputationlevel.note: only here; overallStats and search give the tier alone

goalsPerGame, goalsAgainstPerGame.meaning: goals and goals against divided by games

members/stats.about: Every member's season totals at this club. Whoever controls the CPU gets the CPU's numbers added, as in the match lines.

proOverall, proOverallStr.meaning: the Pro's overall rating (number and the same as text)

proPos.meaning: position number, see lib/ea-assets.ts POSITIONS (5 = CB, 14 = CM, 25 = ST)

proStyle.evidence: 2026-10-11: 0 for mo_nm (Target), Pakst- (Spark), EnEsC-37 (Magician) and dirty8ightt; -1 for the two newest members (x-LadruM-x, RUPPADOR). Maybe a leftover from older games' 'Pro style'

gamesPlayed, winRate, goals, assists, ra.meaning: season totals; include CPU stats for whoever controls the CPU
gamesPlayed, winRate, goals, assists, ra.usedFor: player pages and leaderboard (own goals/assists corrected from saved games)

passesMade, passSuccessRate, tacklesMade.meaning: season totals and % ; include CPU for the controller

cleanSheetsDef, cleanSheetsGK.meaning: 0 for everyone although the club has 4 clean sheets

prevGoals1-10.meaning: goals in each of the last 10 games, 1 = newest
prevGoals1-10.usedFor: goals chart before the site had 10 saved games

prevGoals.meaning: goals in the latest game, same as prevGoals1 (checked for all 6 members)

members/career/stats.about: Every member's all-time totals at this club, with fewer fields than members/stats.

gamesPlayed, goals, assists, manOfTheMat.meaning: all-time totals at this club (the same as this season so far)

matchEventCounters.format: match_event_aggregate_0..3 hold 'id:count' pairs joined by commas; merge all four strings per player
matchEventCounters.keyFinding: The counters count the HUMAN's own actions. EA's headline goals/assists/shots add the CPU teammates' to the controller's line; the counters don't. So they give real per-player stats even for whoever plays ANY.

214.evidence: equals goals on 89/98 lines; all 9 mismatches are CPU-controller lines where the counter is lower

11.evidence: equals assists on 86/98 lines; all 12 mismatches are CPU-controller lines, counter lower

217.evidence: 217 + 218 equals shots on 85/98 lines; all 13 mismatches are CPU-controller lines, counter lower

derived.cpuGoals: club score minus the sum of counter 214 over the club's players (own goals by the opponent land here too); shown as “CPU” among the scorers on match pages and in Discord posts

267.evidence: equal on all 98 lines but only 3 non-zero

56.evidence: correlation 1.00 with saves, only 4 keeper lines

matchEventCounters.notYetDecoded: passes and tackles do not match any single counter or pair; likely split by type (e.g. 174, 175, 215, 216). Revisit with 30+ matches.
matchEventCounters.method: for each id compare per-line values with known stats (exact, correlation, pair sums) and check where mismatches fall
